messages:
IncidentBot: Incident INC-2026-431 — elevated runtime queueing for /v1/generate-embeddings detected. Q depth spiking on shard eu-west-1-gpu-2. Auto-mitigation suggested: reduce max_inflight for embeddings route and enable soft-shedding.
ana_oncall: I'm on it. Quick snapshot: 95% of queued requests are embeddings from a single tenant (tenant: gamedev-inc). Latency p50 -> 1200ms, p95 -> 3.4s. No error rate yet. @ben_eng can you confirm if autoscaling is healthy?
ben_eng: Autoscaler is healthy, no GPU spin-ups. We're seeing long KV cache grows causing longer prep time. Recommending soft-shed for embeddings and temporary quota bump drop for paid tier to free headroom.
carlos_sre: Agreed. Plan: 1) set embeddings max_inflight 32 -> 12 2) enable soft_shedding for embeddings route 3) disable reranker on tier 'enterprise' for next 10m 4) reduce per-tenant burst quota for gamedev-inc to 0.5x. Apply in that order. Any objections?
julia_pm: Heads-up, gamedev-inc is on paid Dedicated; notify account team before reducing burst to avoid surprise. But if customer-facing errors likely, do what you need.
ana_oncall: Noted. Ben, can you run the toggle? I'll send a heads-up to CS.
ben_eng: Running commands now:
```
# set max_inflight
redwoodctl runtime update-route --route embeddings --max_inflight 12 --region eu-west-1
# enable soft shedding
redwoodctl runtime toggle --route embeddings --soft_shedding on
# disable reranker for enterprise
redwoodctl feature toggle --name reranker --scope enterprise --state off --duration 10m
# apply per-tenant quota
redwoodctl quota update --tenant gamedev-inc --burst-multiplier 0.5
```
ben_eng: Commands executed, got 200/ok for all.
carlos_sre: Observability: queue depth dropping from 620 -> 110 in 90s. p95 latencies down to 1.1s. No increased error spikes.
ana_oncall: CS notified: "We are applying emergency traffic shaping to reduce tail latency; expect brief rate limits." Customer reply: "Thanks, please keep us posted."
julia_pm: Thank you. Keep me posted on any customer escalations.
ops-bot: NOTE: Feature toggle 'reranker' disabled for enterprise at 2026-03-17T15:22:10Z by ben_eng.
ops-bot: Quota updated for tenant gamedev-inc, burst multiplier 0.5.
ben_eng: Follow-up: pushed a temporary routing change to fallback to smaller model embeddings-2 for requests over 4k tokens to further reduce run time.
carlos_sre: Runtime metrics look stable. Recommend leave soft_shedding enabled for 15m, then roll back quotas and reranker once healthy for 10m observation window.
nana_oncall: I'll keep monitoring and escalte to postmortem if repeat. For now, incident to be marked 'mitigated' once p95 < 1.2s for 10m.
ben_eng: p95 at 10m = 1.05s, marking mitigated. Will prepare follow-up notes.
nana_oncall: Thanks team. Assigning action items: ben_eng - collect logs for KV growth; carlos_sre - run a dry-run of more aggressive soft shedding policy; julia_pm - coordinate customer comms. We'll reconvene for blameless postmortem tomorrow.
IncidentBot: Incident INC-2026-431 status updated -> MITIGATED by ana_oncall.
